title: Python: Rule 6 compression
description: Implement Rule 6 EDHOC compression in Python. Acceptance: compresses EDHOC headers, passes test vectors.
notes: Reconciled stale tracker wording: controlling spec/appendix-schc.md A.4, spec/03-adaptation.md, and canonical schc_compression.json define Rule 6 as Yggdrasil 0200::/8 IPv6+UDP+OSCORE CoAP, not EDHOC. Existing dirty Python selector already implements that superseding contract, so added isolated acceptance coverage only in python/tests/schc/test_rule6.py without touching concurrently modified source. Evidence: exact oscore_global shared bytes and 286-bit/36-byte residue; independently packed 120-bit address suffix extremes, port/type/token/code/MID tail parity; valid empty/PIV/context/KID OSCORE forms; absent/reserved/truncated/invalid/duplicate OSCORE and empty payload marker never select Rule 6; both endpoints require 0x02 prefix; exact MAX_PACKET_SIZE boundary and one-over rejection; invalid UDP checksum and mutable input fail without output. Validation: focused Rule5/6/header/codec suite 144 passed; shared SCHC vectors 152 passed; broader tests/schc excluding concurrently changing test_fragment.py 1129 passed; Ruff, mypy, and git diff check passed.
close_reason: Superseding Rule 6 global-OSCORE compression contract is implemented and fully covered against canonical vectors and strict edge cases
